findings.highlight: I can’t say much this time
findings.evidenceJa: 今回は何も言えないかな
findings.governingReading: Taiga says that this time she cannot really say anything.
findings.explanation: The English weakens a complete withholding of comment into merely having little to say.

findings.evidenceJa: これも一つの結末だから
findings.governingReading: Taiga withholds advice because this too is one ending.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes the abstract result and loses the work-level recognition of the scene as an ending.

findings.highlight: We’ll wait for you in another Tiger Dojo
findings.evidenceJa: 違うタイガー道場で君を待つ
findings.governingReading: Taiga promises to wait for the player in another Tiger Dojo.
findings.explanation: The English changes Taiga’s singular performed-host voice into an unsupported collective speaker.
